children: According to ChainCatcher citing Onchain Lens, Machi Big Brother (Huang Licheng) recently sold three Bored Ape Yacht Club NFTs, realizing a loss of 155.5 ETH. He had spent 188 ETH on the NFTs and received 32.5 ETH from the sales. BAYC #9770 sold for 10.5 ETH after a 36 ETH purchase; BAYC #4069 sold for 9.5 ETH after a 47 ETH purchase; and BAYC #32 sold for 12.5 ETH after a 105 ETH purchase.

title: Machi Big Brother Sells Three Bored Ape NFTs at a $246,000 Loss
